name: @verichron/etl-db-reader
description: Read-only Postgres query helpers for pipeline_runs / pipeline_stage_status / forensic_records -- the query-side counterpart to @verichron/etl-db-writer. This package never opens a transaction and never writes; it exists so that consumers (apps/epoch today, apps/orchestrator or a future API service later) share one set of query definitions instead of each hand-rolling SELECTs against the same tables. Like etl-db-writer, every function takes an already-open `Db` (pg Client | PoolClient) -- this package does not own a Pool or read DB_* env vars itself, so callers control connection lifecycle and pooling strategy.
